title: Amy Nelson Was a Corporate Feminist Darling. Then a Corporation Upended Her Life.
summary: Amy Nelson, a champion of women in the “girlboss” era, found her family in Amazon’s cross hairs and found herself in a new role as anti-corporate crusader.
